_comment: 2026-10-12 audit of MFNY's trusted matches (503 of 563). Wrong trusted matches whose cause was a missing product: a 2-pack fell on the 1g single cart, a 3-pack on the 4-pack. Reading examples in data/reading_examples.json 'mfny' name the entries this plan creates; until it is written the import leaves those out with a warning. Not written: apply with --write after approval.

edits.why: 'MFNY - Oishii Live Resin Cartridge 2pk - 1g' (description: 'Oishii Live Resin Cartridge 2pk (1g total)') was trusted on the inferred 1g single cart, a different product (recipe notes: Two-Fers get line Two-Fer so a 2 x 0.5g pack is not a 1g cart). No Oishii Two-Fer in the catalog.

'MFNY | 2pk Live Resin Vape Cart The Belafonte (S)' (description: 'Live Resin Cartridges (2-pack, .5 g each)') was trusted on the 1g single cart. Recipe notes list the Belafonte Two-Fer among store-only products the site lacks; the 1g singles ('MFNY's one-gram vape carts ... ACTIVE') stay on the Live Resin 1g cart.

entry.strain: Super Lemon Haze x Super Lemon Haze

edits.why: MFNY sells infused 3-packs (3 x 0.75g = 2.25g): 'MFNY - Super Lemon Haze x Super Lemon Haze Infused Pre-roll 3pk - 2.25g', 'MFNY | 3pk Live Resin Infused Prerolls Super Lemon Haze x Super Lemon Haze (S)', also White Fire OG and Blueberry 2.0 x Blueberry 2.0 3pk 2.25g. Without it 'Super Lemon Haze x Super Lemon Haze | Infused Pre-Rolls | | 3 x .75g | 3pk' (description: 'three packs') was trusted on the 4-pack 3g.
